commands.name: Quick Quote
commands.intent: Show an instant live quote for a security.

commands.name: Description
commands.intent: Company or instrument overview with business description, quote, valuation, dividends, risk and analyst snapshot.

commands.name: Financials
commands.intent: View company income statement, balance sheet or cash-flow statement.

commands.name: Earnings Estimates
commands.intent: Analyst consensus EPS estimates plus historical estimates versus actual earnings and beat/miss record.

commands.name: Earnings Matrix
commands.intent: Historical fundamentals and forward analyst estimates in a quarterly/annual matrix, growth chart and valuation multiples.
features: metric:Sales|EBITDA|Net Income|EPS|Total Assets|Current Assets|Current Liabilities|Shareholder Equity|CFO|CFI|CFF

commands.name: Short Interest
commands.intent: Historical short interest, days to cover, price and volume for an equity.

commands.name: Ratio Analysis
commands.intent: Compare two securities with prices, buy/sell ratio or spread, rolling correlation and regression.

commands.name: Analyst Ratings
commands.intent: Analyst recommendations, upgrades/downgrades and consensus price targets.

commands.name: Dividend Yield
commands.intent: Dividend history, trailing/forward yield, growth, frequency and payment dates.

commands.name: Quote Monitor
commands.intent: Open and manage customizable live watchlists with streaming quote columns.

commands.name: Focus
commands.intent: Minimal distraction-free streaming price view for one instrument.
constraints: supports equities, ETFs, government yields, FX, crypto, indices and futures

commands.name: Time and Sales
commands.intent: Streaming trade tape with every execution's time, price, size, venue and condition.

commands.name: Historical Change Percent
commands.intent: Daily historical absolute and percentage changes with full OHLCV table.

commands.name: World Equity Index
commands.intent: Monitor live prices for major world equity indices.

commands.name: World Equity Index Futures
commands.intent: Monitor world equity-index futures by region with price, change and YTD performance.

commands.name: Intraday Market Map
commands.intent: S&P 500 or DJIA sector wheel showing intraday moves, contributors, gainers and losers.

commands.name: Market Heatmap
commands.intent: Live market-cap-weighted tile heatmap for an index or personal watchlist.

commands.name: Global Commodity Futures
commands.intent: Monitor and compare global commodity futures across energy, metals and agriculture.

commands.name: Forex Pairs
commands.intent: Cross-currency matrix and amount converter for major global currencies.

commands.name: Most Active
commands.intent: Rank session securities by activity, gainers, losers or dollar value.

commands.name: Most Active Options
commands.intent: Find and rank the most actively traded option contracts.

commands.name: Holders
commands.intent: Institutional owners of a company with value, shares and position change from filings.

commands.name: Latest Holdings
commands.intent: Latest holdings owned by a company, fund or instrument.

commands.name: News
commands.intent: Real-time or historical news filtered by security, watchlist, text, source, language, category or date.

commands.name: News Search
commands.intent: Open News with a free-text search term already applied.

commands.name: Top News
commands.intent: Reuters-ranked live Top 15 news headlines.

commands.name: Research Reports
commands.intent: Find and read research reports.

commands.name: Trending on Godel
commands.intent: Rank the most-searched securities across Godel users.

commands.name: Market Halts
commands.intent: Today's U.S. trading halts with reason, halt/quote/resumption times and status.

commands.name: All Quotes
commands.intent: Every related listing and venue quote for a security with bid, ask, last and volume.

commands.name: Securities Finder
commands.intent: Search every Godel instrument and person by free text, class, venue or country.
constraints: also supports bare SECF followed by in-panel search

commands.name: Wojak Index
commands.intent: Live #general-chat sentiment gauge from bullish/bearish and green/pink Wojak usage.

commands.name: Equity Screener
commands.intent: Screen global equities by valuation, fundamentals, market cap, venue, country, sector or subsector.
features: range filters:market cap|forward/trailing P/E|P/S|P/B|P/CF|forward EPS|forward revenue

commands.name: Option Chain
commands.intent: Live option chain with expirations, strikes, prices, volume, IV and Greeks.

commands.name: Black-Scholes
commands.intent: Black-Scholes option pricing, Greeks and implied-volatility calculator.

commands.name: Calculator
commands.intent: Standard scientific arithmetic or time-value-of-money finance calculator.

commands.name: Brokerage
commands.intent: Connect, reconnect or disconnect read-only brokerage integrations through SnapTrade.

commands.name: Brokerage AUM
commands.intent: View global connected brokerage AUM or the user's personal linked-account value.

commands.name: Chart
commands.intent: Historical or real-time TradingView chart with candles, volume, indicators, drawings and alerts.

commands.name: Historical Multiple Security
commands.intent: Compare multiple securities historically on one chart.

commands.name: Historical Prices
commands.intent: Exportable daily, hourly or minute OHLCV history table for an instrument.

commands.name: Graph Fundamentals
commands.intent: Chart company fundamental metrics over time and compare them across companies.
features: margin metric:Gross Margin|Operating Margin|Net Margin|R&D as % of Revenue|SG&A as % of Revenue|Return on Equity
constraints: P/E is exposed but not separately labeled forward versus trailing

commands.name: Filings
commands.intent: Recent or company-specific SEC EDGAR filings with watchlist and filing-type filtering.
features: render inside Godel or open EDGAR

commands.name: Initial Public Offerings
commands.intent: Upcoming and recent IPOs with pricing, exchange, offering details and aftermarket performance.

commands.name: Earnings Hub
commands.intent: Search and read earnings-call transcripts across companies, quarters and years.

commands.name: Pattern Search
commands.intent: Find a historical price pattern and forecast forward returns from similar occurrences.

commands.name: Systematic Pattern Search
commands.intent: Batch and rank systematic patterns with realized outcomes.

commands.name: World Venue Map
commands.intent: World map of stock exchanges showing current open/closed trading status.

commands.name: Citadel Overview
commands.intent: Open Godel's overview of Citadel.

commands.name: Kelly Criterion
commands.intent: Interactive biased-coin betting game demonstrating Kelly sizing.

commands.name: Help
commands.intent: Open built-in command syntax, keystrokes and enabled-command reference.

commands.name: Chat
commands.intent: Open public rooms, ticker rooms, DMs or group chats.
constraints: sending messages is consequential and requires explicit user intent

commands.name: Account Management
commands.intent: Manage profile, subscription, billing and invoice history.

commands.name: Settings
commands.intent: Open terminal appearance, layout, feed, keyboard and command preferences.

commands.name: Alerts
commands.intent: Create and manage desktop price alerts for securities.
constraints: alert mutations require explicit user intent

commands.name: Notes
commands.intent: Create and edit persistent rich-text notes, optionally linked to a security.

commands.name: Entitlements
commands.intent: View and manage add-on exchange feeds and premium feature entitlements.

commands.name: Changelog
commands.intent: Open Godel's versioned product changelog.

commands.name: Bug Report
commands.intent: Report a bug or request Godel support.
